therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PET tracer uptake in hypoxic regions
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: detection and measurement of tumor hypoxia
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with head/neck, lung, liver, rectal or cervical cancers receiving chemotherapy, radiation therapy or chemoradiotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: reproducibility of [F18]HX4 PET imaging in measuring hypoxia in tumors

results.target_engagement_evidence: PET tracer uptake measured by SUV, SUV Max, SUV Mean, and T/B ratio
biomarker_changes: tumor uptake of [F 18]HX4 measured by standard uptake values and tumor-to-background ratios
